title: Weaver: Weaving Preference Evidence through Incremental Reasoning for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized retrieval-augmented generation requires extracting and applying user preferences from extended interaction histories. This task is challenging because preference evidence is scattered across past conversations and remains bound to specific temporal and situational contexts. Consequently, isolated fragments rarely provide complete support for a response, while preferences expressed under different conditions are easily conflated. To address these limitations, we propose Weaver, a framework that incrementally weaves memory-conditioned retrieval trajectories with compositional preference reasoning for personalized responses. Weaver operates on a Dual-Layer Retrieval and Reasoning Graph that couples an upper Intent Dependency Graph with a lower Memory-Conditioned Retrieval Trajectory Graph. translated_title: Weaver：通过增量推理编织偏好证据以实现个性化检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 个性化检索增强生成需要从长期的交互历史中提取并应用用户偏好。这项任务具有挑战性，因为偏好证据分散在过去的对话中，并且与特定的时间和情境上下文紧密绑定。因此，孤立的片段很少能为响应提供完整的支持，而在不同条件下表达的偏好也容易被混淆。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 Weaver，这是一个以增量方式将记忆条件下的检索轨迹与组合式偏好推理相编织的框架，用于生成个性化响应。Weaver 运行在一个双层检索与推理图之上，该图将上层的意图依赖图与下层的记忆条件检索轨迹图耦合在一起。依赖信息缺口追踪用于刻画回答当前请求所需的信息及其前置依赖关系……
tldr: Weaver 框架通过耦合意图依赖图与记忆条件检索轨迹图的双层检索与推理图，以增量方式将记忆条件检索轨迹与组合式偏好推理相编织，解决了个性化检索增强生成中偏好证据分散且跨情境易混淆的问题。
